title: Console shell: the sidebar auto-collapses to an icon rail on narrow windows and expands as an overlay on click, so a 1280 px window keeps room for the split record pane
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

Filed from the record-page epic #26676 as a sub-issue (the maintainer, 2026-10-29: 「另立两张 ui 卡：侧栏窄窗自动折叠、…」; earlier, looking at Attio on a narrow pane: 「窄屏幕左侧菜单自动折叠，点击弹出，这个你也可以参考」). It is console shell work, not record-page anatomy; it makes #27545's default split fit on common laptop windows.

## Source (main `273137d227`)

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/ConsoleLayout.tsx` uses `useIsMobile()`; `ui/packages/components/src/ui/sidebar.tsx` is the shadcn Sidebar with `collapsible: "offcanvas" | "icon" | "none"` (default `offcanvas`), a Sheet below the mobile breakpoint, and a resizable rail (200–480 px, remembered in `localStorage`) above it. Between the mobile breakpoint and any width the sidebar stays expanded, so a 1280 px window leaves 1024 px of content — below what the split (list ≥ 440 + pane 720 = 1160) needs, which #27545 then handles by falling back to the overlay drawer.
- Attio collapses its sidebar to a single icon on narrow windows and expands it as an overlay on click; Twenty keeps a collapsible rail.

## Target

1. **Auto-collapse below a window width of 1100 px**: the sidebar renders as the icon rail (`collapsible="icon"`, the existing `--sidebar-width-icon`), the content area takes the rest; above 1100 px the sidebar behaves as today. The threshold is one named constant beside the record page's 1120 / 760 ones, not a magic number.
2. **Click to expand as an overlay**: clicking the rail (or the sidebar toggle, `⌘B` as today) expands the full sidebar OVER the content, not pushing it; choosing a navigation item, clicking outside, or Esc collapses it again. Hover alone does not expand.
3. **Reader override, remembered**: a reader who expands the sidebar and pins it (the existing toggle in the expanded state) keeps it expanded below 1100 px for that browser; stored where the rail width is stored today. The mobile Sheet below 768 px is unchanged.
4. No metadata key; no spec change; the app's navigation items are untouched.

## File surface

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/ConsoleLayout.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/components/UnifiedSidebar.tsx` (rail rendering of groups and items with tooltips), `ui/packages/components/src/ui/sidebar.tsx` (overlay expand mode), `ui/packages/components/src/hooks/use-mobile.ts` (a second breakpoint hook beside it), i18n for the tooltips, tests beside, changeset; ⛔ `packages/spec/**`.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: at 1280 px the sidebar mounts as the icon rail and the content width is the window minus the rail; a rail click expands an overlay that does not change the content width; a navigation choice / outside click / Esc collapses it; the pinned override persists across a reload; at 1440 px nothing changes; at 700 px the Sheet still mounts.
2. Screenshots at 1280 (rail, overlay expanded) and 1440 (unchanged) on HotCRM, on a never-merged evidence branch.
3. The epic seat verifies in the console preview before ACCEPT (maintainer: 「车队开发完后你审核效果」).
